notes: Comprehensive collection of 100 Alaska animal organizations including shelters, rescues, wildlife rehabilitation centers, sled dog rescues, and bush community programs. Alaska SPCA celebrates 70 years in 2025. Unique challenges include vast distances, roadless communities, and limited veterinary access in bush villages. Major wildlife centers featured on Nat Geo WILD's Alaska Animal Rescue include Alaska SeaLife Center, Alaska Wildlife Conservation Center, and Alaska Raptor Center. Northern Air Cargo donates flights to transport dogs from remote villages like Bethel and Nome. Organizations like Bethel Friends of Canines serve the 75,000 sq mi Y-K Delta region. Coverage spans from Utqiagvik (northernmost US) to Ketchikan in Southeast Alaska.
